coding_context.description: The replication tested framing effects on risk preferences. It confirmed the original finding: participants were risk-averse in the gain frame (e.g., Program A: 200 lives saved) and risk-seeking in the loss frame (e.g., Program B: 400 lives lost).
coding_context.es_repr_o: p. 453, calculated based on given percentages and sample size as in the replication, see https://gist.github.com/LukasWallrich/01eae59cb003c143d1014f7a9a26e882
